predictions: We still have one result yet to come in, but so far last week was a pretty decent one around here. Not the best ever, but a 16-8 week to this point is passable. It's actually my second-worst week so far this season, but if twice as many right as wrong is among the worst, we're doing some- thing right. That brings me to 88-35 (71.5% correct) for the season, and I'm presently at 65% or better in all seven divisions. If stupid Trips Are For Kids (1-4 so far) weren't here, I would kinda be owning this thing…

Match of the week: (D Div.) Reload @ Red-eye Rangers. Nobody in D made it as far at 4-0, and these are actually the only two teams left with as few as one loss. So tonight's winner will sit alone atop the division. The Rangers sit a handful of points behind, but it's possible they are actually the better-positioned team in this race, having already taken down Machine. Alas, I feel like this is a Reload kind of evening, 13-11.

Match #2: (F Div.) Zero Dart Ton 80 @ Shark Shooters. Zero Dart has only even been challenged one night so far this season. But since a week 1 slip-up, the Shark Shooters have been pretty perfect themselves. Now either the F race is going to be completely reinvigorated, or Zero is going to narrow their competitor list a little bit. Zero Dart it is, 15-9.

Match #3: (G Div.) That's What She Said @ Bottoms Up. It's possible (based on the one missing result) that this is a battle of 1-loss teams fighting to be the one staying in stride with Vader's. There's a decent chance these two are actually the top two point leaders in G, so this really could be a G title-race-definer. I have to go with She Said, 15-9.

Matches #4 & #5: (A Div.) 2 Liver Die with LA @ Element XL; Lunatic Fringe @ The Bullies. The 'top two' in A were able to handle their business against the 'next two' in A last week, and now they swap opponents as they try to reach their week 7 showdown without any blemishes on their records. As always, Liver and Fringe are the most dangerous competitors they each will face, so the lead pair once again better not lose focus for a night. I'm thinking both will do what they need to do… Element gets theirs, 16-8; and Bullies ring up the same.

Match #6: (C Div.) Off Constantly-Reboot @ The Outlaws. Shooter McGavin is threatening to run away and hide from the rest of C. But if they slip, the battle to be the next squad up could be getting a bit heated, and this match could be key to that. Outlaws take it, 13-11.

Match #7: (D Div.) Sharky's Machine @ Village Idiots. With one of the 1-loss teams certainly to take a hit tonight (see: match of the week), all the 2-loss teams will find themselves right in the hunt with only one team to pass. The winner here is a 2-losser. Idiots, 13-11.

Match #8: (A Div.) Darty Minds @ Show Me Your Tips. First win of the season in the league's top division coming for somebody tonight. Both of these teams have had a couple close calls already, and maybe this is the start of a mini-run. I'll go Darty Minds, 14-10.

Match #9: (E Div.) Death Throw @ Bangin The Wire. Three teams in E have put a gap between themselves and the bottom five. Is this the fight to see who just leads up that bottom-five-pack? Or is it the first move back into the main fray for the winner here? DT, 13-11.

Match #10: (B Div.) Dart Attack @ One Armed Bandits. So when you look at this, do you see a 5-0 team against a 1-4 in what is likely a blowout? Well, did you consider that the 1-4 team averages 10.8 per week?! No freebie for the leaders this week. Still Attack, 15-9.

Match #11: (F Div.) Coach's Last Dance @ Nein Mark. Maybe this is an early round battle in the fight to see who avoids a bottom- two finish in F (and a possible spot in G next season). Nein Mark is another 1-4 team averaging almost 11 points per week. Nein, 14-10.
Match #12: (B Div.) Double In, Stumble Out @ Put It on Matt's Tab. The Tab looked like a contender until Attack dismantled them last week. And now they have to deal with Stumble. Stumble, 15-9.
